# OCM v1 component archive fixtures

The `ocmv1-component-archive` directory and `.tgz` file were created by
OCM v1 CLI v0.52.0 from `acme.org/archive:1.0.0` with provider `acme.org`:

```sh
ocm create ca --file ocmv1-component-archive --provider acme.org acme.org/archive 1.0.0
ocm create ca --file ocmv1-component-archive.tgz --type tgz --provider acme.org acme.org/archive 1.0.0
```

These are component archives, not Common Transport Format repositories.
